submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 6 mm gives the best energy resolution in the recorded scan at 100 GeV (3.238%, versus 3.326% for F2 at 4 mm and 3.856% for the best F1 point). However, this recommendation is provisional and NOT cleared against the hard dose-rate constraint. The dose-rate evaluation for F1, F2 and F3 returned no numeric result (dose_rate_1m_1week_*_numeric_input_missing = 1; dose_rate_evaluable_count = 0), so no combination could be checked against the 20 uSv/h limit at 1 m after one week of cooldown. The dose requirement is therefore unknown, not met. F2 at 6 mm must not be used for hands-on maintenance until the activation/dose calculation is completed and shows ≤ 20 uSv/h. If F2 fails the dose limit, the next candidates by resolution are F2 at 4 mm and F1 at 6 mm, each also requiring dose verification.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown <= 20 uSv/h (hard requirement)
requirements.evidence: Dose-rate input was missing for F1, F2 and F3 (numeric_input_missing = 1 for each); dose_rate_evaluable_count = 0; combinations_passing_dose_filter = 0; selected_combination_cleared_for_dose = 0. Not verified, so not cleared for hands-on maintenance.
6 mm is within the 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Goal: best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Recorded resolution for F2 at 6 mm is 3.238%, the lowest across all 15 material/thickness combinations scanned (F1 3.856-5.616, F2 3.238-4.585, F3 5.009-7.511). Resolution was not dose-filtered, so this is the best unverified result.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended material and plate thickness
requirements.evidence: Submitted Absorber-F2, 6 mm, with the dose caveat stated in the justification.
